1309-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1379-4693-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-4693-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Overgrown Estate.

2457-2557-2757.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

997-1580-4556-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1849-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7153.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

677-5184-6974.easyPrerequisites:
You have {3}{U}{R} plus one mana of any color available if Ashling's Command is in your hand.
You have {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus one mana of any color available if Ashling's Command is in your graveyard.
677-5184-6974.description:
If Ashling's Command is in your hand, cast it by paying {3}{U}{R}. If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Xorn, and then creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana of four different colors.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Xorn, and then creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to two plus the number of Xorns you control.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 4.
677-5184-6974.notes: You will progressively make more Xorns with each iteration and thus more Treasures. Once you have at least three total Xorns, you can forego making more if desired to choose other modes.

431-851-2557-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-2557-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

4452-5296-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}
Repeat.
4452-5296-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Workhorse for additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3129-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Primal Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3129-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2092-3671-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-3671-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Wily Goblin.
When Wily Goblin enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-1575-2511-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-2511-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

349-1636-2470-5251.description:
Cast Cerulean Wisps by paying {U}, causing Emmara to become blue until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Emmara, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells and/or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2136-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Orthion.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-3525.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, and you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-4373.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1909-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1909-4875.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2440-2744-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2440-2744-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
The Triskelavite enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Triskelavite you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Triskelavite tokens, you may sacrifice them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

985-3847-4574-4659.notablePrerequisites: Arcbound Worker has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
985-3847-4574-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Worker, adding {C}{C}.
Arcbound Worker dies, triggering its modular ability, moving its +1/+1 counters onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Worker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Arcbound Worker from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Arcbound Worker enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1336-1354-2635.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness.
1336-1354-2635.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Heronblade Elite +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Heronblade Elite.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

2605-3525-3932.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
2605-3525-3932.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Lotus Vale and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

539-579-1247.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-579-1247.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
